current.text: Ryan Conwell is a rookie. The Heat drafted him 37th in the 2026 draft. He is an older rookie at 22.
He averaged 17.5 points in Summer League before Miami sent him home early.
Miami lost guard depth and ball handlers in offseason trades, which opens possible rotation minutes for him.
Davion Mitchell is Miami's projected starting point guard. It is still open whether Miami starts a traditional point guard or lets Giannis Antetokounmpo run point.
Dru Smith is injured. Conwell could play ahead of him to start the season.
He could play as many minutes as Davion Mitchell this season. One expert would not be surprised if he is better than Mitchell by the second half.
He is only worth a pick in deep and dynasty leagues. In standard leagues he is a name to watch.
Using the March 28 end date, Miami has a weak 4-3-3 playoff schedule (10 games) with no back-to-backs in those weeks. Miami has the league-minimum 13 back-to-backs this season.

durable.text: His three-point volume is a question. Experts hope he starts taking more threes.
